data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (44,907)

named_events.loss_description: incurred losses were all modest, the largest of which was the earthquake in Taiwan on 3 April 2024.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492 reported a significant gross reserve release of GBP 44.907 million for prior underwriting years in 2024, representing an 18.70% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development is supported by the closing of the 2022 Year of Account with a distributable profit and consistently strong Net Combined Operating Ratios for older underwriting years, indicating benign claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions
The 2022 YOA is closing by Reinsurance To Close (RITC) after 36 months with a cumulative distributable profit of GBP 59.4m
2023 pure year of account forecast to ultimate NCOR of 83.5%; 2022 closed pure year of account forecast ultimate NCOR of 76.9%; 2021 pure closed year at 73.7%; 2020 at 75.1% and 2019 at 83.6%
Property catastrophe activity within the Syndicate's exposure footprint was relatively benign during the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the 2023 External RITC (Reinsurance To Close) of GBP 70.445m, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. The prior year development figure is taken directly from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in the Technical Provisions note.
